First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at @eugeneGEARs the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the GEARs WTNB Wednesday Ride group ride

GEARs WTNB Wednesday Ride is a road and social group ride in Eugene, OR. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Alton Baker Park.

A short evening ride for women, trans and non-binary riders, listed on the GEARs September schedule. About 10 miles at 10–12 mph from Alton Baker Park. GEARs asks riders to sign up online before the ride.
